commentaries.author: parimēlaḻagar
commentaries.text:
At their night meeting place he sees the moon and says this.

The stars in the sky can’t tell their moon from my woman’s face, though the two are very different, and they wander confused from their places. He says this because stars never stay still. It can also mean that only stars who keep their places can tell the two apart, and those who stray can’t.
